help.intro: A carrier is the shipping company a shipment points at — a name plus optional contact details. It holds no rates, zones or tracking logic; it is only the record other features reference.
help.step_1_body: Name is the only required field and must be unique among carriers that are not deleted. A duplicate is refused with a conflict rather than being made unique for you.
help.step_2_body: Optional, and stored as free text rather than checked as a URL — anything is accepted, so keeping the protocol and spelling consistent is yours to do. It is also the second field search reads, alongside the name.
help.step_3_body: Both optional and checked for format only. The phone accepts 7 to 15 digits with an optional leading +, and spaces, dots, dashes and parentheses are ignored; neither field is verified to reach anyone.
help.step_4_body: Free text for the dashboard alone — account numbers, the contact person, the terms behind the contract. It is never searched, so anything you need to find a carrier by belongs in the name or the website.
help.step_5_body: Search matches name and website from three characters, except for an all-digit term, which is treated as an id and matched exactly. The list can be ordered by id, name, created or updated date, and nothing else.
help.note: Deleting a carrier is a soft delete, so shipments already pointing at it keep resolving — use Show deleted to find one and restore it. The uniqueness rule ignores deleted rows, so the name is free the moment it is deleted and a restore fails while another carrier holds it.
